intent.description: Prepare a role-specific interview plan before an enterprise AI application or digital-transformation discovery visit. Use when a transformation practitioner needs to decide whom to interview across an industry, department, role, or bounded process and produce interview objectives, open main questions, adaptive follow-up triggers, minimum evidence requests, coverage gaps, facilitation notes, and client-safe no-promise boundaries. Do not use to conduct the live employee interview, map one employee's workflow, analyze collected transcripts or files, diagnose the transformation route, recommend AI/RPA/Agent technology, estimate ROI, or implement systems.

output_contract: scope, discovery goals, known facts, assumptions and exclusions;
planning constraints, recommended coverage and minimum viable interview combination;
role coverage matrix and interview priority;
expected cross-role disagreement hypotheses with mirrored questions;
role-specific interview guides with objective, main questions, follow-up triggers and rationale;
minimum evidence request grouped by enterprise owner;
coverage gaps, stop conditions and next handoff;
`enterprise_interview_plan` JSON/YAML block with enterprise/project/process identifiers when available.

permissions.file_write: only when the user requests an exportable interview plan

evidence_boundary.public_claim_policy: claim only what local validation, install proof, human review, or provider-backed evidence actually supports
